# Adding hubble link to web console application menu

[[Back]](../README.md)

![Example](../../images/hubble/console.png)

OpenShift supports creation of custom links in the web console as explained in the [official documentation](https://docs.redhat.com/en/documentation/openshift_container_platform/4.22/html/web_console/customizing-web-console#creating-custom-links_customizing-web-console). 

```
apiVersion: console.openshift.io/v1
kind: ConsoleLink
metadata:
  name: cilium-hubble
spec:
  href: 'https://hubble-timescape-cilium.apps.bm1.ocp.domain.com'
  location: ApplicationMenu
  text: Hubble
  applicationMenu:
    section: Cilium
```

The `spec.href` field **must be https** as such you need to make sure that timescape UI is exposed with [TLS enabled](./configuration-timescape-ui.md#tls-ui).

The custom console link can be enhanced with image defined in `spec:applicationMenu:imageURL` that **must be** an HTTPS URL or a Data URI. The image should be square and will be shown at 24x24 pixels. 

In this example the transparent hubble logo png file as below is Data URI encoded. Use any png-to-data-uri tool or base64 encode offline the content of the binary file.

![Logo](../../images/hubble/logo.png)

```
apiVersion: console.openshift.io/v1
kind: ConsoleLink
metadata:
  name: cilium-hubble
spec:
  applicationMenu:
    imageURL: 'data:image/png;base64,'
    section: Cilium
  href: 'https://hubble-timescape-cilium.apps.bm1.ocp.domain.com'
  location: ApplicationMenu
  text: Hubble
```
